For kappa=3/ln2 or9/2, C+kappa I(F) is nonnegative and full-query superharmonic. For every K>=0, adding sum_j q_j rho_K(g_j), where rho_K is the complete inner stopping hull of (H-KI)_+, gives a nonnegative full-query superharmonic majorant A_K of (H(F)-K I(F))_+. Thus dimension-independent initial influence funding at any fixed K is FEI-equivalent for arbitrary choices of partition, not only singleton cores.
